candidate_workaround: Treat the memory registry filename as a lead, then resolve one bounded suffix match before reading the rollout summary.
failure_signature: The registry-named rollout summary path was absent even though a differently named file with the same stable suffix remained available.
recurrence_guard: Use an exact filename first, then at most one suffix-scoped rg --files recovery; never broad-scan private rollout content.
rollback: Give the stale pointer zero read credit, retain the miss, and stop if the bounded suffix search is not unique.
scope_boundary: Same-owner memory lookup recovery only; no authority, identity continuity, or repository evidence credit.
title: Resolve stale memory rollout pointers with one bounded suffix search
trigger_preconditions: A current memory registry entry names a rollout summary that is absent at that exact path.
